user.title: Create Virtual Device Entity
user.description: Create a virtual entity attached directly to an existing device, or as a standalone virtual device.

init.title: Virtual Entity Options
init.description: Adjust the configuration and values of this virtual entity.

set_value.name: Set Virtual Value
set_value.description: Updates the state or value of a virtual entity attached to a device.

value.name: Value
value.description: The new state, number, or text value to set.

reset.name: Reset Virtual Entity
reset.description: Resets the virtual entity to its initial default state or sets timestamp to now.
